explanation: For gaming purposes, a good CPU is needed. The AMD A10-6800K provides a balanced performance for gaming. The Radeon RX 6800 GPU provides a good level of graphics performance. The ASRock 760GM-HDV motherboard is a compatible option for the CPU. 32 GB of RAM provides ample memory for gaming. A 256 GB SSD provides fast storage for the OS and games. The 850 W power supply provides sufficient power for the build.
